entries.source_quote: Triumphant Roar (P): at full charge, heals himself and all nearby allied champions
Molten Shield (E): can target an allied champion, granting a shield plus decaying bonus movement speed
Going Rogue (W): killing a Scoundrel resurrects all allied champions that Scoundrel had slain
Caretaker's Shrine (W): first ally to enter is healed and gains decaying bonus movement speed
Magical Journey (E): terrain portal Bard and allies travel through at 33% increased speed
Tempered Fate (R): places all units hit, including allied champions, into untargetable stasis
Braum W Stand Behind Me: leaps to a target allied champion; the ally gains bonus Armor and Magic Resist for a few seconds
Fiora R Grand Challenge: if she hits all four Vitals or the target dies, Fiora and her allies in the area are healed over the next few seconds
Galio R Hero's Entrance: designates an ally's position and grants all allies in the landing area a magic shield
Hwei W Subject: Serenity (Pool of Reflection shields allied champions inside, Fleeting Current grants allies move speed)
Ivern Q Rootcaller: allies can dash to the target rooted by his vine
Ivern W Brushmaker: Ivern and nearby allies' attacks deal bonus magic damage while in brush
Ivern E Triggerseed: places a shield on an ally that explodes to slow and damage enemies
Janna Passive Tailwind: Janna's allies gain bonus move speed while moving toward her
Janna E Eye of the Storm: shields an ally champion or turret and increases their attack damage
Janna R Monsoon: soothing winds heal nearby allies over the channel
Jarvan IV E Demacian Standard: flag grants bonus attack speed to nearby allied champions
Jayce E Acceleration Gate: increases the move speed of all allied champions who pass through it
Karma E Inspire: shields a target ally and grants them bonus movement speed
Karma R+E Defiance (Mantra-empowered Inspire): AoE shield to the target plus a halved shield and haste to nearby allies
Kayle W Celestial Blessing: heals a target ally and grants both Kayle and the ally bonus movement speed
Kayle R Divine Judgment: grants a targeted ally invulnerability for the duration
Kindred R Lamb's Respite: zone preventing all allied units inside from dying, then heals them when it ends
Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!: leaves a draft trail granting bonus movement speed to allied champions who follow it
Lulu W Whimsy (ally cast): grants the target ally bonus attack speed and bonus movement speed
Lulu E Help, Pix! (ally cast): Pix jumps to an ally and shields them (80-240 +55% AP) and aids their attacks
Lulu R Wild Growth: enlarges target ally granting bonus health (275-575 +55% AP) and knocking up nearby enemies
Lux W Prismatic Barrier: wand passes through allies shielding each (40-100 +40% AP), then re-shields on return
Milio P Fired Up!: his abilities enchant allies on touch so their next damage deals bonus magic damage plus a burn
Milio W Cozy Campfire: empowering zone heals allies inside over time and increases their attack range
Milio E Warm Hugs: shields the target ally (45-165 +45% AP) and grants bonus movement speed, 2 charges
Milio R Breath of Life: heals and removes crowd control from nearby allies and grants them tenacity
Morgana E Black Shield: grants target ally a magic-damage shield (100-320 +70% AP) and crowd-control immunity until broken
Nami P Surging Tides: her abilities grant bonus movement speed to allied champions hit
Nami W Ebb and Flow: stream bounces between allied and enemy champions, healing allies hit
Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing: empowers an ally's next basic attacks and spells to deal bonus magic damage and slow
Nami R Tidal Wave: allies hit gain double the effect of Surging Tides (amplified bonus movement speed)
Nidalee E Primal Surge: heals an allied champion and grants them bonus Attack Speed (scales with target missing HP)
Nilah P Joy Unending: enhances and shares nearby healing and shielding from her allies to nearby allied champions
Nilah W Jubilant Veil: allies she touches gain ghosting, Move Speed, magic damage reduction, and attack-dodge
Nilah R Apotheosis: heals herself and nearby allied champions for a percent of damage dealt to enemy champions
Nunu P Call of the Freljord: increases the Attack Speed and Move Speed of a nearby ally
Orianna E Command: Protect: attaches the ball to an ally, shielding them and granting bonus Armor and Magic Resist
Ornn Living Forge: upgrades allies' completed items into Masterwork items, granting allies bonus stats
Pyke R Death from Below: the assisting ally on an executed kill also receives full kill gold
Rakan Q Gleaming Quill: on hitting a champion or epic monster, restores Health to himself and nearby allies
Rakan E Battle Dance: dashes to an allied champion, granting them a Shield
Rell E Full Tilt: Rell and a target ally gain ramping Move Speed (doubled toward enemies and each other)
Renata W Bailout: grants an ally bonus Attack Speed + Move Speed toward enemies (also delays death once, but death is not prevented without a takedown)
Renata E Loyalty Program: a pair of chemtech missiles grant a shield to allies hit for 2.5 seconds
Senna Q Piercing Darkness: beam restores Health to allied champions it passes through
Senna E Curse of the Black Mist: allies in the mist gain Move Speed, Camouflage, and become unselectable Wraiths
Senna R Dawning Shadow: global beam grants a Shield to allied champions hit in the wider area
Seraphine W Surround Sound: shields nearby allies + grants them Move Speed, and heals them if she is already shielded
Shen W Spirit's Refuge: zone blocks all basic Attacks against allied champions standing inside it
Shen R Stand United: grants a target allied champion (anywhere on the map) a missing-health-scaling Shield, then teleports to them
Sivir R On The Hunt: grants nearby allied champions a surge of Move Speed for the duration
Ryze R Realm Warp: opens a portal that teleports allies near it to the marked location (out-of-combat repositioning utility)
Sona Q Hymn of Valor Melody Bonus: Sona and tagged allied champions deal bonus magic damage on their next basic attack
Sona W Aria of Perseverance: heals the most wounded nearby allied champion; Melody bonus also shields tagged allies
Sona E Song of Celerity Melody Bonus: tagged allied champions gain bonus movement speed
Soraka R Wish: heals all allied champions globally, increased 50% on targets below 40% health
Soraka W Astral Infusion: heals the target allied champion (also grants Rejuvenation regen under Starcall buff)
Taric R Cosmic Radiance: he and nearby allied champions become invulnerable for 2.5 seconds
Taric W Bastion: shields the target allied champion, tethers and grants them bonus armor, mimicking his abilities to them
Taric Q Starlight's Touch: heals himself and nearby allied champions per stocked charge
Tahm Kench R Devour on ally: swallows an ally rendering them untargetable and displacement-immune, granting a decaying shield
Thresh W Dark Passage: first allied champion near the lantern is shielded and can dash to Thresh
Xayah W Deadly Plumage: if Rakan is nearby on cast he is also empowered, gaining bonus attack speed and 30% movement speed
Yuumi W You and Me!: while Attached, grants the anchored ally adaptive Adaptive Force (AD or AP)
Yuumi E Zoomies: heals the Attached ally and grants Move Speed, Attack Speed and mana regen
Yuumi R Final Chapter: each wave heals nearby allied champions
Zilean E Time Warp: grants an allied champion a large Move Speed boost for a short time
Zilean R Chronoshift: protective rune on an ally, on lethal damage Stasis then revive and heal
